meta.directive: Redesign Work as a physical sticky-note corkboard with handwritten pen ink. Keep Mohit project data and site brand colors (#1a1a1a / #3498db / #61dafb).

concept.name: Desk sticky board
concept.one_liner: A dark desk surface scattered with pastel sticky notes, titles written in pen handwriting, existing pen assets as the writing tool motif.
concept.why: Ties Work to Mohit's unique pen-split Skills motif — craft / sketch / think — instead of generic tech cards or cinematic media tiles.

keep.links: All existing Behance / Netlify / WordPress URLs unchanged

visual_system.surface: Dark desk (#0f0f0f) with subtle cork/fiber grain — not flat purple

sticky_palette.rule: Pastels are PAPER only — ink uses brand blue + near-black, never terracotta/purple-theme

typography.ink_body: Instrument Serif italic for short descriptions (optional) OR Caveat at smaller size
typography.meta: IBM Plex Mono for tiny #ms-000n codes only

chrome: Soft drop shadow + lifted hover (rotate settles toward 0, translateY −8px)
Washi-tape strip or pin dot at top of each note
Hand-drawn underline on hover for links (SVG stroke or border-image feel)
Floating wholepen.png / penled.png as section decoration (absolute, parallax light)

layout.desktop: Irregular masonry / scattered board — 3 columns with staggered offsets, not a rigid equal card grid. Notes overlap the desk atmosphere slightly.
layout.mobile: Single column stack, still rotated ±3deg, drag optional
layout.section_header: Handwritten 'Work' in Caveat large; mono subtitle 'pinned ideas → projects'; small ink doodle line

motion.enter: Notes flutter in (opacity + rotate from larger angle → resting tilt), stagger 60–90ms
motion.hover: Note lifts, tape peels slightly, title ink darkens to --brand
motion.pen: Pen asset drifts slowly (CSS float) as if resting on the desk
motion.reduced_motion: No flutter — notes appear at rest angles only

implementation.a11y: Preserve semantic list of links; don't rely on color alone; respect reduced-motion

anti_patterns: Equal 3-column bootstrap grid of identical notes
Copying wodniack video strip for this mode
Warm cream page background replacing dark site chrome
